data.one_liner: Flutter test tools and extensions to simulate human-computer interactions.
data.what_it_does: Provides WidgetTester extensions to easily simulate keyboard shortcuts, hardware keyboard text input, IME text input, and popular mobile device viewports in Flutter tests.
use_when: You want to simulate human keyboard shortcuts and text input easily in widget tests.
You need to test your Flutter app layout across multiple popular mobile device viewports.
avoid_when: You are not writing Flutter widget or integration tests.
strengths: Adds many convenient shortcut methods for WidgetTester.
Supports both hardware keyboard and IME text input simulation.
Includes built-in configurations for popular mobile devices like the iPhone 16 Pro Max.
data.setup_notes: Add flutter_test_robots to dev_dependencies in pubspec.yaml.
